newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Life EGM approves Lippo Bank deal.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Life EGM approves Lippo Bank deal.

text.p: Shareholders of Lippo Life said on Friday they had approved a company proposal to buy an additional 40 percent stake in Lippo Bank.
They said after an extraordinary general meeting that the proposal was approved by 61 percent of voting shareholders.
The purchase, part of a massive restructuring of the Lippo group's financial subsidiaries, will take Lippo Life's stake in Lippo Bank to 45 percent.
Later on Friday, shareholders of Lippo Securities are to vote on a proposal to raise its stake in Lippo Life to 32 percent from the existing four percent.
The 875 billion rupiah transactions are to be financed mostly by loans, the Lippo group has said.
